jopara.note: Mostly text generation models with Jopara token support, Feb-Aug 2025

key_findings: There is NO pre-trained Paraguayan Spanish model on HuggingFace — P3 has to build from scratch OR fine-tune Spanish baseline
Guarani HAS 97 models but mostly ASR (speech-to-text), not text classification/sentiment
Jopara search returns 66 models but mostly large LMs (3B-8B parameters), not domain-specific

p3_baseline_strategy.approach_1: Fine-tune pysentimiento/robertuito-sentiment-analysis (Spanish sentiment baseline) on Jopara/Spanish Paraguayan corpus
p3_baseline_strategy.approach_2: Use MarIA / BETO (Spanish BERT) + fine-tune on Paraguayan-specific data
p3_baseline_strategy.approach_3: Take an existing Guarani ASR encoder and fine-tune for text classification

next_steps: Download and test pysentimiento/robertuito on sample Spanish Paraguayan text
Check if any HuggingFace user has uploaded a Jopara dataset (datasets search)
Search for 'paraguayo' OR 'paraguayan' user uploads on HF
Check INPE / FIUNA publications for any associated model uploads
